analysis.H3: per seed compare crossing count and median first crossing with noncrossings coded H+1=101; favorable if more crossings OR smaller median; adverse if fewer OR larger median
analysis.S1: within-seed median over 3 ages, then median/min/max/IQR across 5 seeds; strict paired direction counts
analysis.unit: independent seed; checkpoint age is a repeated measure
analysis.verdict: SUPPORTED if H1/H2/full>m hold in all 5 seeds and H3 favorable in >=3 with no adverse seeds; NOT SUPPORTED if H1 or H2 holds in <=2 seeds; otherwise MIXED RESULT

architecture:
CNN(
  (0): Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
  (1): ReLU()
  (2): Conv2d(32, 32, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
  (3): ReLU()
  (4): MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)
  (5): Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
  (6): ReLU()
  (7): Conv2d(64, 64, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
  (8): ReLU()
  (9): MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)
  (10): Conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))
  (11): ReLU()
  (12): AdaptiveAvgPool2d(output_size=(1, 1))
  (13): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
  (14): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=10, bias=True)
)

batch_construction.pairing: same precomputed indices and same prepared batch object for all branches

dataset: official CIFAR-10 python version; 50000 train / 10000 test
failure_policy: record every failure; no selective rows; post-collection bug invalidates affected cohort; rerun whole affected cohort in new directory
functional_evaluation: entire official 10000-example test split; batch size 256; loss and accuracy

hypotheses.H1: reset-v produces larger seed-level median S1 than reset-m
hypotheses.H2: reset-v produces larger seed-level median S1 than full reset
hypotheses.H3: reset-v causes more rapid or more frequent trajectory divergence than reset-m
hypotheses.H4: reset-v > full reset > reset-m ordering survives architecture/task change

metrics.crossing: first distance >= tau; null if censored at H=100

optional_epsilon.analysis: seed medians across ages; epsilon replay-only; supporting evidence
optional_epsilon.condition: primary completes and estimated extra runtime <120 seconds

pilot.decision: original architecture and hyperparameters learn; no changes; keep 5 seeds and requested ages

rewrites.full_per_parameter_reset: empty per-parameter state restarting m/v/step; preserve parameter groups and scheduler
rewrites.reset_m: clear exp_avg only; preserve all else
rewrites.reset_v: clear exp_avg_sq only; preserve all else
